channel.title: Live: MOTD FIFA World Cup 2026
channel.desc: Live coverage as World Cup debutants Uzbekistan play their final Group K game against the Democratic Republic of Congo in Atlanta. Uzbekistan are managed by 2006 World Cup winning captain Fabio Cannavaro, with Abdulkodir Khusanov in the centre of their defence. Last appearing in the 1974 World Cup as Zaire, the Democratic Republic of Congo enjoyed an impressive qualifying campaign for the 2026 tournament, drawing in Senegal before knocking out both Cameroon and Nigeria in the African play-offs.
